body.objective: Demonstrate a validated numerical path from endpoint enclosures to a Schwarzschild connection matrix and conserved-current defect bound.
body.stop_condition: Audit the landed Forge exact, arbitrary-precision, interval and validated-ODE machinery against a representative axial first-order system. Produce a deterministic pilot enclosing a fundamental matrix, basis-conditioning error and T^dagger J_infinity T-J_horizon residual on one declared radial and frequency box, or file the smallest typed Forge request containing the missing primitive and certify why uncontrolled shooting is insufficient.
body.current_gate: Validated connection and conservation enclosure preflight
body.forbid: no floating-point residual called proof; no producer rerun treated as independent verification; no global physics conclusion from a toy system; no hidden scipy/mpmath dependency without version and error model
body.resource_hint: Prefer the landed Forge math kernels. If a primitive is absent, stop with a narrow executable request rather than building an unverified local substitute.
